name: FirstUK Bank Application Landscape
description: Internal technology reference document defining the application landscape and system architecture for FirstUK Bank. Serves as authoritative guidance for technology staff, architects, developers, and operations teams on application portfolio and integration context.
context: Audience | Technology Staff, Architects, Developers, Operations

name: FirstUK Bank Customer
description: Natural persons who hold accounts, products, or banking relationships with FirstUK Bank as referenced in operational and systems documentation.
context: Provide a complete catalog of all applications, systems, and platforms used by FirstUK Bank
context_role: end user of FirstUK Bank services

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The primary banking institution referenced throughout this systems and applications catalog. FirstUK Bank operates multiple products, systems, and platforms to serve its customer base.
context: all applications, systems, and platforms used by FirstUK Bank

name: Account Management System
description: Core system component responsible for account management operations within the banking infrastructure. Interfaces with the API Gateway and connects to the Data Warehouse for analytics and reporting.
function: Account management and customer account operations

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Online banking service component that provides customers with digital access to banking services. Connects through the API Gateway and feeds data to the Data Warehouse.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: System component dedicated to fraud detection and monitoring. Integrated into the core system landscape and reports to the Data Warehouse for analytics.

name: Payment Processing System
description: Payment processing component that handles payment transactions within the banking system. Connects to the API Gateway and Data Warehouse infrastructure.

name: API Gateway
description: Central API management platform providing authentication, rate limiting, and documentation services. Routes requests from all customer channels (Branch, Online Banking, Mobile App, Phone/Chat) to backend systems.
role: Central integration point for all customer channels

name: Data Warehouse
description: Central data repository supporting analytics and reporting functions across the banking system. Receives data from all core system components (AMS, IBP, FDE, PPS).

name: Branch Channel
description: Physical branch banking channel through which customers can access banking services. Part of the multi-channel customer access landscape.

name: Online Banking Channel
description: Digital online banking channel providing customers with web-based access to banking services. Routes through the API Gateway.

name: Mobile App Channel
description: Mobile application channel enabling customers to access banking services via smartphone or tablet. Connects through the API Gateway.

name: Phone and Chat Channel
description: Customer support channel providing phone and chat-based access to banking services and assistance. Routes through the API Gateway.

name: Account Management System
description: Core production system responsible for account management operations. Built on Java Spring Boot microservices architecture with PostgreSQL database, deployed on AWS Kubernetes infrastructure. Maintains 99.9% availability SLA and is owned by the Head of Technology with support from Database and Application teams.
context: Technology Stack: Java Spring Boot microservices, PostgreSQL

name: Head of Technology
description: Executive owner of the Account Management System responsible for overall technology strategy and system governance.
trigger_condition: System owner for Account Management System

name: Database Team
description: Support team responsible for database operations and maintenance of the Account Management System infrastructure.
context: Support Team: Database team, Application team
trigger_condition: Support team for Account Management System

name: Application Team
description: Support team responsible for application development and maintenance of the Account Management System.
context: Support Team: Database team, Application team
trigger_condition: Support team for Account Management System

name: Customer Account
description: A banking product that serves as the central repository for customer accounts, balances, and transaction ledger management.
context: Central repository for customer accounts, balances, and transaction ledger

name: Customer Account
description: An account held by customers that maintains balances and transaction records within the central repository system.
context: Central repository for customer accounts, balances, and transaction ledger
purpose: holds customer balances and transaction ledger

name: Transaction Ledger
description: The transaction ledger maintained as part of the central repository, recording all financial events and account activity.
context: Central repository for customer accounts, balances, and transaction ledger

name: Account
description: A banking product supporting core account operations including creation, reading, updating, and deletion. Accounts maintain balance calculations, reconciliation, and immutable transaction ledgers with interest calculation capabilities.

name: Account
description: A customer account subject to CRUD operations, balance reconciliation, transaction ledger maintenance, and interest calculation. Account status is actively managed throughout its lifecycle.

name: Transaction Ledger
description: An immutable record of all financial events on a customer account. The transaction ledger maintains a complete audit trail and is used for balance reconciliation and account reconciliation purposes.

name: Interest Calculation
description: Interest calculation functionality applied to account balances. The system computes and applies interest according to defined rate schedules and account terms.

name: Customer
description: Individual customers holding banking relationships with the institution. The data entity references 500 customer records maintained in the operational system.

name: Account
description: Customer accounts held within the banking system. The data entity references 800 account records across all product types.

name: Account Holder
description: Persons with legal rights and obligations over accounts, including support for joint account arrangements. The system maintains account holder records with joint account support capability.

name: Transaction
description: Financial events on customer accounts including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and payments. The system processes 2,000+ transactions monthly across all active accounts.

name: Standing Order
description: Standing order payment instructions set up on customer accounts for recurring payments. The system maintains 50+ active standing orders across the customer base.

name: Direct Debit
description: Direct debit mandates established on customer accounts for recurring payment collection. The system maintains 30+ active direct debit mandates across the customer base.

name: Database Failure
description: A failure or unavailability of the PostgreSQL 13+ database system that supports core banking operations. This incident type encompasses database crashes, replication failures, backup failures, or performance degradation that impacts transaction processing and customer account access.

name: Backup Failure
description: Failure or corruption of the daily encrypted database backup process to S3, preventing recovery capability in the event of primary database loss or corruption.

name: Replication Failure
description: Failure or interruption of continuous replication from the primary PostgreSQL database to the standby instance, compromising high-availability and disaster recovery capability.

name: Account
description: A banking product that can be created, retrieved, and used to record transactions and check balance via API endpoints. Accounts are the primary entity managed through the exposed API interface.

name: Transaction
description: A financial event recorded on a customer account through the API. Transactions can be posted to an account and are tracked as part of account operations.

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: External integration point that supplies account data to the banking system. Serves as a source for customer account information and queries.

name: Mobile Banking App
description: External integration point that handles account queries from mobile customers. Provides real-time access to account information via mobile channels.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: External system that monitors and analyzes transaction data for fraud patterns. Supplies transaction data to the banking operations system for risk assessment.

name: Payment Processing System
description: External integration that processes payments and updates account balances in real-time. Provides balance update notifications to the core banking system.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Central repository that receives nightly batch data exports from the banking system. Serves as the analytics and historical data store for reporting and compliance.

name: Monthly Patching
description: Scheduled monthly system patching performed on Tuesdays between 2–4 AM to maintain system security and stability. This is a routine operational maintenance window.

name: Daily Backup
description: Scheduled daily backup execution performed at midnight to ensure data protection and recovery capability. This is a critical operational control.

name: Monthly Data Archiving
description: Scheduled monthly archiving process that moves old data to cold storage for long-term retention and cost optimization. Performed as part of routine data lifecycle management.
context: Archiving: Monthly (old data to cold storage)

name: Internet Banking Platform
description: Active production internet banking platform serving customers for online account access and transaction management. Built on React.js frontend and Node.js/Express backend, deployed on AWS ECS infrastructure with 99.8% availability SLA.

name: Head of Technology
description: Executive owner responsible for the Internet Banking Platform. Primary escalation point for platform-level incidents and technology decisions.
trigger_condition: System owner for Internet Banking Platform

name: Frontend Team

name: Web-Based Customer Portal
description: A web-based platform enabling customers to access their accounts and perform self-service operations. The portal provides digital access to account management functions without requiring branch visits or phone contact.
context: Web-based customer portal for account access and self-service

name: Secure Login with Two-Factor Authentication
description: Customer-facing guidance on the secure login feature using two-factor authentication via one-time password (OTP) for account access.

name: Account Dashboard
description: Customer-facing guidance on accessing and using the account dashboard feature.

name: Transaction History
description: Customer-facing guidance on viewing and accessing transaction history through the online platform.

name: Standing Order Management
description: Customer-facing guidance on setting up, amending, and managing standing order payment instructions through the online platform.

name: Direct Debit Authorization
description: Customer-facing guidance on authorizing and managing direct debit mandates on the customer account.

name: Money Transfer
description: Customer-facing guidance on initiating and managing money transfers between accounts through the online platform.

name: E-Statements
description: Customer-facing guidance on accessing and managing electronic statements through the online platform.

name: Profile Management
description: Customer-facing guidance on updating and managing personal profile information and account settings.

name: Daily Active User
description: Customer population metric tracked for system performance and capacity planning. The bank maintains 200–300 daily active users during normal operations.

name: Monthly Transaction Volume
description: Aggregate transaction volume processed by the bank on a monthly basis. The system handles 500+ transactions per month as a baseline operational metric.

name: Response Time Performance Target
description: System performance requirement specifying that 95th percentile response time must remain below 2 seconds. This metric is monitored to ensure customer-facing operations meet service level expectations.

name: Peak Traffic Window Monitoring
description: Identified peak traffic period during which the system experiences maximum load and transaction volume. Peak traffic occurs between 10:00–12:00 GMT daily, requiring heightened monitoring and capacity management.

name: User
description: A user of the banking system subject to rate limiting controls of 100 requests per minute. Users are identified individually for the purpose of applying security rate limits.
context_role: generic user subject to security controls

name: Session Timeout
description: Automatic termination of user sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity. This is a security control to prevent unauthorized access to abandoned sessions.

name: TLS 1.3 Encryption
description: Encryption standard applied to all data in transit between the customer and the banking system. TLS 1.3 is the current industry standard for secure communication.

name: XSS/CSRF Protection
description: Security controls implemented to protect against cross-site scripting (XSS) and cross-site request forgery (CSRF) attacks. These are standard web application security measures.

name: Account Management System Integration
description: Integration with the Account Management System (AMS) for account queries and transaction initiation. This system is a critical dependency for customer account operations and transaction processing.

name: Fraud Detection Engine Integration
description: Integration with the Fraud Detection Engine (FDE) for fraud scoring on transfer transactions. This system provides real-time fraud risk assessment for payment operations.

name: Payment Processing System Integration
description: Integration with the Payment Processing System (PPS) for payment submission. This system handles the submission and routing of customer payments through the payment network.

name: Native Mobile App

context: Native mobile app for iOS and Android devices.

name: Account Dashboard

name: Push Notification

name: Card Management Feature
description: Customer guidance on managing payment cards through the mobile application, including the ability to lock and unlock cards for security purposes.

name: Money Transfer Feature
description: Guidance on initiating money transfers between accounts or to external recipients through the mobile application.

name: Virtual Card Number Feature
description: Customer guidance on generating and using virtual card numbers for secure online transactions and merchant payments.

name: Fraud Detection Engine
description: A production system responsible for detecting fraudulent transactions and activities across customer accounts. Deployed on AWS infrastructure using Python and TensorFlow with Apache Kafka for event streaming. The system maintains a 99.7% availability SLA and is owned by the Head of Financial Crime.
context: Technology Stack: Python, TensorFlow, Apache Kafka

name: Head of Financial Crime
description: Executive owner responsible for the Fraud Detection Engine system and financial crime operations. Primary escalation point for fraud detection system incidents and performance issues.
trigger_condition: Fraud Detection Engine incidents and alerts
context_role: System owner and primary escalation contact

name: Data Science Team
description: Technical support team responsible for maintaining and supporting the Fraud Detection Engine, including model development and optimization.
context: Support Team: Data science team, DevOps
trigger_condition: Fraud Detection Engine support and investigation

name: DevOps Team
description: Infrastructure and deployment support team responsible for maintaining the AWS deployment and operational availability of the Fraud Detection Engine.
context: Support Team: Data science team, DevOps
trigger_condition: Fraud Detection Engine infrastructure and deployment issues

name: Real-time Fraud Detection
description: A continuous monitoring system designed to identify and flag potentially fraudulent transactions as they occur. This real-time detection capability enables immediate intervention and risk assessment on customer accounts.
context: Real-time fraud detection and transaction risk scoring

name: Fraud Detection Obligation
description: Real-time fraud detection system employing transaction risk scoring, rule-based detection with 20+ fraud rules, ML-based anomaly detection, velocity checks, and geographic anomaly detection. The system operates with sub-100ms latency and includes auto-blocking capability for high-risk transactions.
investigation_or_escalation_path: Risk scoring and rule-based detection system

name: Transaction Monitoring
description: Ongoing screening of real-time transactions from AMS/PPS systems to detect suspicious activity patterns. Integrates customer profile data and historical transaction data to identify anomalies and potential money laundering risks.

name: Transaction Risk Model
description: A predictive model that scores transaction fraud probability on a 0–100 scale. Used to identify and flag potentially fraudulent transactions for investigation and response.
context: Transaction Risk Model — Predicts fraud probability (0–100)

name: Fraud Detection Rate
description: Performance metric for fraud detection system capability, measured at 97% or higher. This metric indicates the system's ability to identify fraudulent transactions and activities across monitored accounts.

name: Account Management System
description: Upstream integration providing transaction stream data to the fraud detection and monitoring system. AMS feeds real-time transaction events that are scored and assessed for fraud risk.

name: Intelligent Behavioral Profiling
description: Upstream integration providing real-time transaction scoring based on behavioral analysis. IBP scores incoming transactions to identify anomalies and potential fraud patterns.

name: Payment Processing System
description: Upstream integration performing transfer risk assessment on payment transactions. PPS evaluates transfer requests for compliance and fraud risk before processing.

name: Fraud Alert Storage
description: Downstream database system that stores and maintains fraud alerts generated by the transaction scoring and risk assessment integrations. Serves as the authoritative record of fraud detection events.

name: Payment Processing System
description: Active production system responsible for payment processing, deployed on AWS using Kubernetes with Java, RabbitMQ, and Spring Boot technology stack. Maintains 99.95% availability SLA and is owned by the Head of Technology with support from the Payments team.
context: Technology Stack: Java, RabbitMQ, Spring Boot

name: Head of Technology
description: Executive owner of the Payment Processing System responsible for system governance and escalation decisions.
trigger_condition: System owner for Payment Processing System

name: Payments Team
description: Support team responsible for operational management and incident response for the Payment Processing System.
trigger_condition: Support and operational issues with Payment Processing System

name: Payment Processing Service
description: A banking service responsible for processing customer payments and managing inter-bank settlement transactions. This service handles the core operational flow of payment instruction execution and settlement between financial institutions.
context: Process customer payments and inter-bank settlements
primary_function: Process customer payments and inter-bank settlements

name: Faster Payments Scheme
description: Real-time payment scheme supporting transfers up to £1 million. Enables immediate fund movement between accounts across participating banks.

name: BACS Payment Scheme
description: Overnight batch payment scheme designed for high-volume transaction processing. Typically used for bulk payments and regular recurring transactions.

name: CHAPS Payment Scheme
description: Real-time payment scheme for high-value transactions. Provides same-day settlement for large fund transfers between financial institutions.

name: Internal Transfer Service
description: Payment mechanism enabling fund transfers between accounts held within the same bank. Typically processed with minimal delay.

name: Faster Payment Service Processing
description: Customer guidance on Faster Payment Service (FPS) processing, which provides immediate settlement of payments. This is one of the three primary payment channels available to customers for fund transfers.
topic: Faster Payment Service (FPS) processing and settlement

name: BACS Payment Processing
description: Customer guidance on BACS payment processing, which requires submission by 20:00 and settles the following day. This is a batch clearing system for routine payments.

name: CHAPS Payment Processing
description: Customer guidance on CHAPS payment processing, which provides real-time settlement during business hours. This is the high-value, same-day clearing system.

name: Performance Degradation
description: A system incident characterized by reduced transaction throughput, increased processing latency, or decreased success rates below established operational baselines. This incident type is identified by monitoring key performance indicators including daily transaction volume, success rate percentage, and FPS processing latency.

name: AMS Integration
description: Integration point receiving payment instruction data from the AMS system. This inbound integration is critical for payment processing workflows and represents a potential failure point in the payment instruction pipeline.

name: FDE Integration
description: Integration point receiving fraud assessment data from the FDE system. This inbound integration feeds fraud detection and risk assessment processes into the payment and account management workflows.

name: Bank of England Settlement Integration
description: Outbound integration to the Bank of England for settlement of payments and clearing operations. This is a critical external dependency for final payment settlement and regulatory compliance.

name: External Banks Payment Delivery Integration
description: Outbound integration to external banking partners for final payment delivery. This integration enables interbank payment routing and represents a critical dependency for customer payment execution.

name: Data Warehouse
description: Production data warehouse system deployed on AWS infrastructure, supporting nightly batch and real-time data updates. Utilizes AWS Redshift, Apache Spark, and S3 technologies for data storage and processing. Owned by Head of Technology with support from the data engineering team.
context: Technology Stack: AWS Redshift, Apache Spark, S3

name: Head of Technology
description: Executive owner responsible for the Data Warehouse system (DW-001) and its operational governance.

name: Data Engineering Team
description: Support team responsible for the operational maintenance and technical support of the Data Warehouse system.

name: Fraud Detection Dashboard

name: Compliance and Risk Dashboard
description: A dashboard consolidating compliance monitoring, regulatory risk assessment, and operational risk metrics. Supports compliance and risk management oversight.

name: Customer Analytics Dashboard
description: A dashboard providing analytics on customer behavior, account activity, and customer lifecycle metrics. Supports customer relationship management and segmentation analysis.

name: Supporting Systems

name: Relationship Management

name: Sales Pipeline

trigger_condition: Reporting and regulatory system ownership and oversight

name: Regulatory Report Generation
description: The operational process of generating and filing regulatory reports including COREP (Common Reporting), FINREP (Financial Reporting), and CASS (Client Assets) reports as mandated by regulatory authorities.

name: COREP Report
description: A regulatory reporting obligation for capital requirements. COREP reports are submitted to demonstrate compliance with capital adequacy standards and regulatory capital thresholds.

name: FINREP Report
description: A regulatory reporting obligation for financial statements. FINREP reports provide standardized financial information to regulators on a periodic basis.

name: CASS Report
description: A regulatory reporting obligation for client assets. CASS reports document the bank's handling, safeguarding, and reconciliation of customer assets held in trust.

name: AML Suspicious Activity Report
description: A regulatory filing obligation to report suspicious activity detected through AML monitoring and transaction screening. These reports are submitted to the relevant financial intelligence authority when transactions or customer behavior meet suspicious activity thresholds.

name: Data Engineering Team
